messages:
nina: Proposal: graded-reserve lockers for fallback. Goal: avoid single-tenant drain while keeping warm caches. Short sketch + rollout.

nina: Problem: global fallback pool allows bursts to evict healthy tenants. Graded-reserve gives each tier a reserve plus a soft borrow band that decays over time.

marco: How is this different from slabs/lockers?

nina: Key differences: graded reserves adjust based on observed warmness and cost pressure. Borrowed capacity decays (rate-limited) rather than instant revoke; runtime gets preempt hints to do graceful flush.

tara: Runtime needs a clear contract. Suggest token: {locker, reserve_level, borrowed_until}. Runtime callback `preempt_hint(token)` returns {accepted,bool, est_rewarm_ms}. If est_rewarm_ms>grace_ms we back off.

nina: Proto-config (tiny):

```
graded_reserve:
  pool_mb: 524288
  tiers:
    - name: hobby
      base_pct: 5
      borrow_pct: 10
    - name: team
      base_pct: 50
      borrow_pct: 30
    - name: pro
      base_pct: 45
      borrow_pct: 60
  grace_ms: 30000
  borrow_decay_sec: 120
  warmness_weight: 0.6
```

marco: Telemetry: `reserve_used_pct`, `borrowed_mb`, `warmness_score`, `preempt_hints_accepted`, `rehydrate_ms_estimate`. Alert on >8% p95 increase for any pro-tier during advisory.

tara: Rollout: dry-run -> advisory (runtime honors hints) -> enforced. Include a chaos test that spikes a hobby-tier tenant. Ops-bot: schedule dry-run 2026-04-18 02:00 UTC.

ops-bot: simulation_scheduled thread=1812222222 mode=dry-run start_ts=1812228800

nina: Owners: nina=policy, marco=telemetry/dashboards, tara=runtime hooks. I'll draft RFC follow-up with this config and test matrix.

marco: LGTM.

tara: lgtm, minor: make borrow_decay configurable per-tier later.

nina: noted. Filing RFC follow-up after sim. Thanks.
